about: The falsifier: a reader that runs over its place was offered its sources alone, so a lot that moved only a leaf a view writes never reached it. At epoch 277 lane A withdrew three exports from topos and topos/package.json rendered without them; reader/json-vectors, which reads the manifest and dist, was never run again, and audit/tree/exports-resolve kept reading 3 where the count is 0.

And the fix that offers every leaf of the place is wrong: receipts.bound is a leaf a view writes from what the readers said, so every pass moved the offer it had just read. On a copy at epoch 280, four passes in a row rendered obligations', topos' and verify's receipts again, and json-vectors ran three times each pass.

cases.name: every non-foreign leaf offered, four passes on a copy
